Capitalism is defined as private ownership of the means of production, and is characterized by a strict, hierarchical class division between the working class and the ruling class. The profit motive is all consuming. As you can see, these economic situations are not compatible. You cannot have a dictatorship of the proletariat, in which the sole class and ruling class is the working class, and the class divisions of capitalism. You cannot both manufacture goods to meet human needs and profit, because profit incentives rarely align with human needs. And you cannot have the average workers control the means of production while having a tiny minority of people control the means of production at once. Capitalism and socialism are not mutually compatible. One common misconception about socialism is that “socialism is when the government does stuff.” That is incorrect, as government intervention in the economy can occur in capitalist countries. Social democracies, such as those found in the Nordic Countries, are capitalist with a strong social safety net. In conclusion, socialism cannot work in a capitalist economy. This battle saw X-Wings under Rogue Squadron and Kyp’s Dozen, along with capital ships under Keyan Farlander, as well as Hapan forces under Tenel Ka, destroy a large Vong fleet under commander Komm Krash. This battle was important for four reasons. First off, it saw the first use of Yammosk Jammers. The extra-galactic invaders the Yuuzhan Vong employed war coordinators, called jammers. The New Republic had created a Yammosk Jammer to stop the Yammosk’s ability to coordinate Yuuzhan Vong fleets, however, it had become ineffective. The New Republic realized they were using a second Yammosk and so employed a second Yammosk Jammer for the first time, which was crucial in their victory. Yammosks like the one above coordinated the Vong effort, and allowed Vong ships to have a level of coordination similar to that granted by battle melds. Second off, the fleet under Komm Krash was the last Yuuzhan Vong extra-galactic reserve fleet. By destroying it, the Vong could expect no further reinforcements- which seriously hurt Yuuzhan Vong morale. Thirdly, it helped New Republic morale immensely. Obroa-Skai was a world of cultural significance to the New Republic, as it held the largest libraries in the galaxy. By retaking it, the New Republic not only showed that the Vong weren’t unbeatable but they also reclaimed an important planet. Finally, this was the first time Hapans and the New Republic had worked together since the disastrous Battle of Fondor. This combined victory helped build respect and trust between the two allies- something that would be needed for the upcoming Battle of Coruscant. After sending in various probes and spies, they invaded the galaxy in 25 ABY. The Vong were a warrior culture, and used completely organic technology. Everything, from their starships to battlecruisers to melee weapons, were living beings. The Vong (partly because of a devastating war between to droid races in their galaxy) were extremely technophobic.
